bug.title: After a search from the search page's own box, the header search box still shows the previous query (empty, or the query the page was loaded with)
bug.symptoms: global-nav.tsx useSearchQuery (~L107-125) reads ?q= from location.search only when the pathname changes or on popstate. A search typed in the page's own box changes only ?q= with window.history.pushState (search-page.tsx defaultUpdateUrl, ~L132-160), so the header box is not told. Seen with Playwright on the verify app @ c5f5bf6: full load of /search?q=calibration, page-box search "Rafael Silva" → the page shows "3 results for “Rafael Silva”" while the header box still reads "calibration" (from an empty /search it stays empty). Back/Forward afterwards resync it (popstate)
bug.reproduction_steps: Open /search?q=calibration. In the page's own search box type "Rafael Silva" and press Enter: the results are for "Rafael Silva", the header search box says "calibration"
bug.expected: Per D1: after any search, filter or mode change the search page writes to the address bar, the header box shows the URL's q (the same as after a full load of that URL), unless the reader is typing in the header box at that moment (focused field: do not overwrite the draft). Back/Forward behaviour from round 25 is unchanged; no extra search requests; no synthetic popstate. Tests: search-page.test.tsx asserts the event is dispatched once per URL write (push and replace) and not when the URL is unchanged; global-nav.test.tsx asserts the header box follows the event to the new ?q=, ignores it while focused, and removes the listener on unmount
bug.actual: The header box shows a different query from the one on the page
